basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Superintendent, Personal Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Graduates up to 30 years of age can apply for 3 Superintendent and 2 Personal Assistant posts (Group B, Pay Level 06) at the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST), Shibpur, Howrah, an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Applications are made online on the SAMARTH portal from 9 November 2026 to 9 December 2026 (11:55 pm), followed by a Google Form submission by 14 December 2026 (11:55 pm).

age_limit.details: The age limit for direct recruits to both posts is 30 years, counted as of the last date for submission of the application form. | Category Relaxation Departmental Candidates Up to five years, in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government Other relaxation, if any As per Central Government Rules | Any relaxation claimed must be supported by valid documents or certificates in the candidate's name. The OBC (NCL)/EWS certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026, otherwise the application is considered in the unreserved (UR) category. PwD candidates need proof of disability of not less than 40% from a competent medical authority, valid on the closing date of the online application. | For the full eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification and the Recruitment Rules annexed to it.

selection_process: Selection is through Stage-I (Written Test) and Stage-II (Skill Test). The final merit list is prepared solely on the performance in the Written Test
subject to qualifying in the Skill Test and the recommendation of the Selection Committee.
Only the marks obtained in the Written Test are considered for preparing the merit list. If two or more candidates get the same marks

the tie is broken in this order: the candidate with more positive (correct) marks in the Written Test; then the candidate with higher age by date of birth; then the candidate with a higher percentage of marks in the examination for the minimum academic qualification of the post.
Superintendent: knowledge in Computer applications viz.
Word Processing and Spreadsheet. Personal Assistant: a minimum speed of 100 w.p.m. in stenography.
Qualifying in the Skill Test is mandatory to be considered for selection. The dates of the written test and skill test are not specified in the notice.
how_to_apply: Applications must be made through both the SAMARTH portal and the Google Form. Applications submitted only through the SAMARTH portal or only through the Google Form will not be considered, and applications through any other mode will not be considered.
Open the SAMARTH Recruitment Portal (iiestsnt.samarth.edu.in) and fill the online application form with correct details for every item, from 9 November 2026.
Pay the application fee: Rs. 1500/- for General/EWS/OBC(NCL) candidates and Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST/PwD candidates. Payment instructions are provided within the SAMARTH Recruitment portal.
Complete the final submission on the SAMARTH portal by 9 December 2026, 11:55 pm.
Download the filled application form after final submission.
Make a single PDF file of the application form and self-attested photocopies of the certificates, testimonials and documents uploaded on the SAMARTH portal.
Submit that single PDF through the Google Form (forms.gle/4NY2VrS6dudkrBaZA) on or before 14 December 2026 by 11:55 pm. Google Form submissions after this time will not be considered.

Candidates employed in Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs must apply through the proper channel, addressed to Registrar, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, P.O.-Botanic Garden, Howrah 711103, writing "Application for the Post of Superintendent" or "Application for the Post of Personal Assistant", as applicable, on the envelope. An advance copy must be submitted online on the SAMARTH portal by the due date and time. These candidates must bring a No Objection Certificate from their present employer to the written test and skill test, and, if selected, submit an updated Vigilance Clearance Certificate during physical document verification.
Filled application form downloaded from the SAMARTH portal
Self-attested photocopies of certificates, testimonials and documents uploaded on the SAMARTH portal
Disability certificate from a competent medical authority, for PwD candidates
Vigilance Clearance Certificate (employed candidates, if selected)

content_sections.heading: About IIEST Shibpur
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education (MoE), Government of India, located at P.O. Botanic Garden, Howrah-711 103, West Bengal. This recruitment is a direct recruitment to non-teaching positions of the Institute, issued by the Office of the Registrar. The eligibility criteria follow the NITs Non-teaching Recruitment Rules 2019, the recommendation of the Oversight Committee and the relevant notifications issued by the MoE until the selection process is completed.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 5 posts in total, with the following category-wise distribution. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the advertised posts. Reservation rules of the Government of India apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The posts are open to Indian nationals. Age, qualifications and experience are counted as of the last date for submission of the application form. First Class Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent from a recognized University or Institute in any discipline, OR Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Knowledge of Computer applications viz., Word processing, Spread Sheet. Bachelor's degree in any discipline or its equivalent from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum speed of 100 w.p.m. in stenography. All degrees, diplomas and certificates must be from Universities/Institutions recognized by the Competent authority. Applicants should be physically fit and mentally sound. The prescribed qualifications are the bare minimum, and holding them does not ensure a call for the written test and/or skill test. The age limit for direct recruits to both posts is 30 years, counted as of the last date for submission of the application form. Any relaxation claimed must be supported by valid documents or certificates in the candidate's name. The OBC (NCL)/EWS certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026, otherwise the application is considered in the unreserved (UR) category. PwD candidates need proof of disability of not less than 40% from a competent medical authority, valid on the closing date of the online application. For the full eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification and the Recruitment Rules annexed to it.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry PB-2 (Rs.9,300 - 34,800/-) with a Grade Pay of Rs.4200/-, shown as Pay Level 06 under the 7th CPC. Both are Group B posts. Period of probation: 1 year for direct recruits as per NIT Statutes. Under the Recruitment Rules, 75% of Superintendent posts are filled by direct recruitment, and 50% of Personal Assistant posts are filled by direct recruitment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be made through both the SAMARTH portal and the Google Form. Applications submitted only through the SAMARTH portal or only through the Google Form will not be considered, and applications through any other mode will not be considered. Open the SAMARTH Recruitment Portal (iiestsnt.samarth.edu.in) and fill the online application form with correct details for every item, from 9 November 2026. Pay the application fee: Rs. 1500/- for General/EWS/OBC(NCL) candidates and Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST/PwD candidates. Payment instructions are provided within the SAMARTH Recruitment portal. Complete the final submission on the SAMARTH portal by 9 December 2026, 11:55 pm. Download the filled application form after final submission. Make a single PDF file of the application form and self-attested photocopies of the certificates, testimonials and documents uploaded on the SAMARTH portal. Submit that single PDF through the Google Form (forms.gle/4NY2VrS6dudkrBaZA) on or before 14 December 2026 by 11:55 pm. Google Form submissions after this time will not be considered. Candidates employed in Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs must apply through the proper channel, addressed to Registrar, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, P.O.-Botanic Garden, Howrah 711103, writing "Application for the Post of Superintendent" or "Application for the Post of Personal Assistant", as applicable, on the envelope. An advance copy must be submitted online on the SAMARTH portal by the due date and time. These candidates must bring a No Objection Certificate from their present employer to the written test and skill test, and, if selected, submit an updated Vigilance Clearance Certificate during physical document verification. Filled application form downloaded from the SAMARTH portal Self-attested photocopies of certificates, testimonials and documents uploaded on the SAMARTH portal Valid caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS), if applicable Disability certificate from a competent medical authority, for PwD candidates No Objection Certificate (employed candidates) Vigilance Clearance Certificate (employed candidates, if selected)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through Stage-I (Written Test) and Stage-II (Skill Test). The final merit list is prepared solely on the performance in the Written Test, subject to qualifying in the Skill Test and the recommendation of the Selection Committee. Only the marks obtained in the Written Test are considered for preparing the merit list. If two or more candidates get the same marks, the tie is broken in this order: the candidate with more positive (correct) marks in the Written Test; then the candidate with higher age by date of birth; then the candidate with a higher percentage of marks in the examination for the minimum academic qualification of the post. Superintendent: knowledge in Computer applications viz., Word Processing and Spreadsheet. Personal Assistant: a minimum speed of 100 w.p.m. in stenography. Qualifying in the Skill Test is mandatory to be considered for selection. The dates of the written test and skill test are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts: 3 Superintendent (OBC(NCL) 1, UR 2) and 2 Personal Assistant (UR 2).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application on the SAMARTH portal closes on 9 December 2026 at 11:55 pm, and the single-PDF submission through the Google Form closes on 14 December 2026 at 11:55 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Superintendent post?
faq.answer: A First Class Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, or a Master's Degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade, plus knowledge of Word processing and Spread Sheet.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Personal Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in any discipline or its equivalent from a recognized University/Institute and a minimum speed of 100 w.p.m. in stenography.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit for direct recruits is 30 years, counted as of the last date for submission of the application form, relaxable for departmental candidates up to five years and otherwise as per Central Government Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for IIEST Shibpur Superintendent and Personal Assistant?
faq.answer: Both posts carry PB-2 (Rs.9,300 - 34,800/-) with Grade Pay of Rs.4200/-, which is Pay Level 06 under the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1500/- for General/EWS/OBC(NCL) candidates and Rs. 1000/- for SC/ST/PwD candidates, paid as per the instructions on the SAMARTH Recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q8. Is submitting only on the SAMARTH portal enough?
faq.answer: No. Applications submitted only through the SAMARTH portal or only through the Google Form will not be considered; both are required.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through a Written Test (Stage-I) and a qualifying Skill Test (Stage-II); the final merit list is based only on Written Test marks, subject to qualifying the Skill Test and the Selection Committee's recommendation.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the tests?
faq.answer: No. The Institute will not pay Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance for the written test and/or skill test.
